info.title: KineGuide AI Main API
info.description: Public Go API for the privacy-preserving KineGuide educational prototype. Raw camera frames, images, and video are explicitly excluded from every request.

tags.name: Assessment
tags.description: Bounded structured answers without clinical interpretation.

tags.name: Health Profile
tags.description: Account-owned self-reported profile data stored without clinical interpretation.

tags.name: Exercises
tags.description: Non-prescriptive movement demos pending clinical review.

tags.name: Educational Clinical Flow
tags.description: Demo-only screening and pending-review movement metadata with no clinical decision.

tags.name: Conversations
tags.description: Account-scoped AI chat history retained until the user deletes the conversation or account.

post.summary: Create an account and refresh session

201.description: Account created; rotating refresh token is set as an HttpOnly cookie.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password

200.description: Signed in; rotating refresh token is set as an HttpOnly cookie.

post.summary: Rotate a refresh token and issue a new access token

200.description: Access token refreshed and refresh cookie rotated.
Provider availability without credentials or internal configuration.

get.description: Sets a short-lived HttpOnly state cookie and redirects to the provider. No provider token is returned to the browser.

302.description: Redirect to the configured provider authorization page.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: One-time authorization code from the provider.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Anti-forgery state returned by the provider.

get.summary: Validate the provider callback and start or link a KineGuide session

303.description: Redirect to the fixed web callback with a safe success or error code. A successful login sets the KineGuide refresh cookie.

delete.summary: Delete the account and all consent, assessment, token, identity, and session records

get.summary: List social identities connected to the current account

200.description: Connected provider names and connection timestamps; provider subjects and tokens are excluded.

post.summary: Start an authenticated social-account linking flow

200.description: Provider authorization URL bound to the authenticated KineGuide user.

delete.summary: Disconnect a social identity when another login method remains

200.description: Latest structured assessment or null; this is not a diagnosis.

post.description: Stores bounded structured answers without clinical interpretation or free text.

get.summary: Get the authenticated account's health profile
get.description: Returns the latest account-owned profile or null. Values are self-reported and are not a diagnosis, eligibility decision, or treatment recommendation.

put.summary: Create or replace the authenticated account's health profile
put.description: Idempotently stores bounded self-reported values for 365 days under health-profile-v1 consent. The profile is not used to personalize the current demo plan or make clinical decisions.

200.description: Profile created or replaced without evaluation.

delete.summary: Delete the authenticated account's health profile
delete.description: Idempotently removes the account-owned profile before its retention deadline.

200.description: Non-prescriptive movement demos pending clinical review.

get.description: Requires active prototype consent. Every returned clinical-content record is pending clinical review, demo-only, not for clinical use, and has no reviewer or source claim.

post.summary: Evaluate only the non-clinical demo stop placeholder
post.description: This endpoint does not interpret symptoms or make a medical-safety decision. It routes one synthetic placeholder answer to either stop the demo or list pending-review demos.

get.summary: Get a seven-day demo activity schedule
get.description: Returns a deterministic exploration schedule using movement demos pending clinical review. It is not personalized, does not use assessment answers, and contains no prescription, dosage, pain score, or treatment guidance.

200.description: Self-recorded activity summary; it is not a recovery score.

post.description: Starts a summary record. Raw camera media is not accepted.

post.summary: Get non-clinical technical camera feedback for an owned session
post.description: Sends only pose status and bounded landmark-visibility values to the internal Python service. Raw frames, images, video, landmark coordinates, diagnosis, treatment, automatic dosage, and clinical suitability are excluded and nothing is persisted.

post.summary: Create a conversation after explicit AI-chat storage consent

201.description: Conversation created and retained until user deletion.

delete.summary: Delete a user-owned conversation and all messages

get.summary: List retained messages in a user-owned conversation

post.summary: Generate and persist one user/assistant exchange
post.description: Requires explicit AI-chat storage consent. Requests to view movement demonstrations are answered deterministically from the pending-review educational catalog without selecting an exercise for a symptom or calling the AI provider. Other messages use the internal AI dependency; if it is unavailable, neither the submitted message nor an assistant response is persisted.

201.description: The persisted user and assistant messages.

ai_chat_storage.description: Explicit consent to retain account-scoped AI chat until the user deletes the conversation or account.

birth_date.description: Self-reported birth date used to display age only.

sex.description: Optional self-description; unspecified is always available.

track_weight.description: Preference to keep the current weight available for later review; no weight-history series is created.

recent_injury.description: Self-reported recent injury; not interpreted by the API.

clinician_managed.description: Whether a professional has previously managed the user's movement concern.

warning_signs.description: Self-reported current concerns. `none` must not be combined with another value; the API stores but does not interpret these answers.

equipment.description: `none` must not be combined with another value.

camera_preference.description: Browser-camera facing preference only; no media is uploaded or stored.

activity_notifications.description: Stored notification preference only; saving it does not request browser permission or schedule a notification.

notes.description: Optional user-entered context. This may contain health information and is never sent to the AI service.

profile_storage_consent.description: Explicit health-profile-v1 consent to retain this account-owned profile for up to 365 days.

reviewedBy.description: Remains null while pending clinical review.

reviewedAt.description: Remains null while pending clinical review.

personalized.description: This schedule is not selected from assessment or health information.

landmark_visibility.description: Derived visibility scores only; coordinates and raw media are forbidden.

Session.description: Minimal session summary. Raw camera media, frames, recordings, and landmarks are never stored.

total_seconds.description: Sum of self-recorded session time in seconds.

retention_policy.description: The conversation remains stored until its owner deletes the conversation or account.
